facility.title: BHOS Table Tennis Hall & Court Allocation
facility.subtitle: Table 1 dedicated for Women / Girls; Tables 2, 3, and 4 dedicated for Men / Boys.
facility.allocation_desc: Table 1 is strictly dedicated for Women & Girls. Tables 2, 3, and 4 are assigned for Men & Open Free Play.
facility.equipment_desc: Donic 3-Star ITTF balls and standard club paddles can be collected from the Sports Complex desk.
facility.footwear_desc: Non-marking indoor sports court shoes are strictly required to preserve professional rubberized flooring.

hall_tables.table_1_sub: Dedicated for BHOS Female Athletes & Students
hall_tables.table_1_desc: Prioritized exclusively for women and girls practice sessions, friendly rallies, and official female league championship fixtures.
hall_tables.table_1_active: Ayan Aliyeva & BHOS Female Club Members
hall_tables.table_2_desc: Primary arena table equipped for official BHOS ELO ranked matches, varsity selection trials, and tournament knockouts.
hall_tables.table_3_desc: Specialized for topspin looping, footwork drills, serve-and-attack routines, and training sessions led by Head Coach Iftixar Meherremov.
hall_tables.table_4_desc: Open to all engineering students for casual sparring, doubles matches, and rapid winner-stays-on campus challenges.
hall_tables.table_4_active: Ali Abdulov, Ali Aghayev, Huseyn Muradzade, Fateh Memmedli
